findings.title: getForLogin cache loses the ordering of login identity providers
findings.body: The delegate getForLogin stream has a deterministic order, but the cached path collects internal IDs into a Set (Collectors.toSet at line 229/238) and then copies them into a HashSet at line 244 before returning identityProviders.stream(). HashSet iteration order is unrelated to the delegate/guiOrder order, so once the cache is used the login providers can be returned in a different, unstable order than on the uncached/invalidated path. Callers that do not re-sort (and the login-page ordering contract) will see IdPs shuffled. Preserve order (e.g. LinkedHashSet / ordered list) when caching and reconstructing the result, as the ID set is the only thing stored.

findings.title: Test cleanup registers removal of a literal "alias" IdP instead of the created IdPs
findings.body: Inside the loop creating idp-alias-0..19, cleanup is registered as testRealm().identityProviders().get("alias")::remove, using the literal string "alias" rather than the loop alias ("idp-alias-" + i). The same literal is used again at line 425. Cleanup therefore tries to remove a non-existent IdP named alias and leaves the 21 created providers behind, which can pollute subsequent tests/methods sharing the realm and mask or cause failures unrelated to the cache assertions. Register cleanup for the actual alias created in each iteration.
